title: Meta launches BlenderBot 3 public demo; Bloomberg reports it repeated election and antisemitic conspiracy claims within days
summary: Meta added a note on 8 August saying the demo would help build more robust conversational AI.

title: President Biden signs the CHIPS and Science Act, which CNBC calls a China competition bill
summary: The law includes a USD 20bn authorization for the NSF technology directorate and funding for AI-related workforce programs.

title: OpenAI publishes new content-moderation tooling
summary: The OpenAI blog post is titled 'New-and-Improved Content Moderation Tooling'.

title: Cyberspace Administration of China publishes details of 30 registered algorithms from Alibaba, Baidu, Tencent and others, Bloomberg reports
summary: The list gives each algorithm's type and function.

title: Russian Defence Ministry says it launched a department for AI development, announced at the Army-2022 expo
summary: C4ISRNET reports the announcement on 17 August.

title: NIST publishes second draft of its AI Risk Management Framework with a partial playbook
summary: Public comment on the draft was open until 29 September.

title: Russian deputy PM Chernyshenko says a National Artificial Intelligence Center will launch in September
summary: Speaking at the Army-2022 forum, he described a platform for finding and analysing AI solutions for business, science and government.

title: Stability AI releases Stable Diffusion, a free open-source text-to-image generator
summary: CSET's newsletter says the model can run on consumer hardware.

title: TechCrunch: users share AI-generated pornographic images, some of real people, from unfiltered Stable Diffusion versions
summary: The 24 August article reports the images circulating on 4chan and Reddit after unfiltered versions of the model appeared.

title: Shanghai official says the city is drafting China's first provincial-level local regulation to promote AI
summary: The statement came at a 26 August press conference introducing the 2022 World Artificial Intelligence Conference.

title: Midjourney-made image wins the digital art category at the Colorado State Fair, 3DJuegos reports
summary: The entrant, Jason Allen, refined the image through prompts, and the win drew objections from artists.

title: US restricts Nvidia and AMD exports of top AI chips to China and Russia; Nvidia says it now needs licences for two chips
summary: The Russian-language report dated 1 September cites the New York Times on the 31 August restrictions.
